opening.argument: The promotion centers on a Bitcoin-related platform presented as a way to earn 12% monthly: the description recommends using a platform “which has been at a growth rate of 12% monthly,” and the speaker says, “I got a way that you can be earning it 12% monthly.” Viewers are then directed to contact the speaker, check the site, and obtain a Bitcoin wallet. The presentation reinforces this financial pitch through compounding language and encouragement to earn Bitcoin daily. Disclaimers about financial advice and risk, along with references to Mirror Trading International videos, provide context but do not remove the advertised return or the requested next steps.
